Name: (CP) Fio's Sparkle Digspot
Author: PocoFio
Description:
[b][size=4]About this mod[/size]

[/b]Do you find the vanilla artifact/seed spots hard to notice, or perhaps a bit too cluttered for your map?
This mod replaces these digspots with [b]single sparkle[/b]!
They flash regularly on the map, easily spotted even while jogging past, yet without being overly conspicuous.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2][b]Simplicity[/b]: Removes cluttered lines and replaces them with an elegant sparkle.[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2][b]Vanilla Friendly[/b]: Use vanilla color palette to ensure a seamless visual experience.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Supports Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
You can freely enable or disable Artifact Spots and Seed Spots separately.


[size=4][b]Translation[/b] [/size](only in config)

[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Traditional Chinese[/*]
[/list]
Free to translate without permission even though it's too simple to do it.

[b][size=4]Note[/size][/b]

This is my first mod, I feel happy to start with this tiny step. If I miss something, pls leave a comment remind me.
Hope everyone enjoy this simple mod, ty <3
